header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. This petition was
body: filed in the year 2021 and was lastly fixed in the court on 14.07.2021, but thereafter no efforts were made to proceed with the same.
Perusal of the prayer clause reflects that the petitioner has approached this Court seeking directions to respondents Nos.2 and 3 to reopen the auction proceedings advertised for the year 2021-2022.
Since the auction process was of the year 2021-2022; therefore by lapse of sufficient time, this petition has become infructuous and is hereby disposed of. JUDGE JUDGE Salik
